# LaunchLoom progress update - 2026-10-23

## Real-intake cafe concept preview: Case Study Coffee Roasters (2026-10-23)

- User requested a real Portland cafe intake, researched with the builtin browser
  and built with FAL-generated media. Chosen business: Case Study Coffee
  Roasters, a verified Portland cafe/roastery with six locations (including a
  PSU location and a drive-thru location coming soon), direct trade and
  seasonal coffees, subscriptions, wholesale, espresso catering, whole-bean

- This is an independent, unaffiliated concept for internal evaluation only.

  unaffiliated notice and must not reuse the business's photography, logo,
  reviews or testimonials.
- Intake issue #185; creative-only run 39971574919 on the pinned
